campaign.behavior: Preserve published flag/status; unknown status localized as unknown. Strict timezone/calendar validation, positive int64 IDs, exact Decimal pool, unique IDs and at most one current cycle. Do not infer payouts from dates.

leaderboard.rules: Keep returned order/rank/ties, require matching campaign IDs and unique address keys; EVM case-insensitive, Solana base58 case-sensitive. Validate bounded full response then show first100,20/page; no fabricated full ranking or100+ personal rank. Total and campaign readers stay separate.

personal.validation_basis: Production frontend Ec/FJt/UJt and UI field usage; synthetic fixtures only. No live address-bearing endpoint requested. Actual personal response/permission remains unverified.
personal.summary: Root totalPoint/currentPoint required; settledPoints/specialPoints optional unknown. Response address if present must match requested address.
personal.history: Root items array with campaignNumber, points and optional campaignName/address. Missing selected cycle is unknown, never zero.
personal.privacy: Only explicit user read/refresh discloses currently authenticated EVM address to fixed Vanta origin; no token/signature, extra wallet creation or Aster account change. Identity ID/address/wallet kind changes clear data, input selection and in-flight generations. Signing availability is not needed for this unsigned read.

integrity: Raw numeric JSON tokens retain lexemes; Decimal scores/pools, bounded integers and strings; no binary floating-point or missing-value zero coercion. Vanta Orderly broker program clearly labeled separately from Aster trading/balances; do not imply Aster activity qualifies for rewards.
lifecycle: Public readers load on page entry and foreground resume, share/deduplicate requests and support manual retry. Five minutes marks stale without polling. Private reads never auto-refresh. Failures keep prior snapshot with warning, background/stop/dispose invalidates late completion; repository lives until final reader leaves. Scroll preserves page state until navigation away. Changed/removed selector options keep selected ID and unknown values rather than silently switching scope.
transport: GET only, fixed HTTPS origin, Accept application/json only, no redirects/retries;12second timeout; safe localized error mapping. No raw payload/server errors shown.
